constraints: Test AHC booking state machine rules. Dates must respect: 4 days in advance, Mon-Sat only, no past/today dates. Use testdata for valid values.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: AHC edge - Sunday date rejected
goal: Verify bot rejects a Sunday as appointment date (only Mon-Sat allowed)

phases.description: Start AHC booking and reach the appointment date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for preferred appointment date

phases.description: Calculate the next Sunday and enter it — the AI should compute which upcoming date is a Sunday
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects Sunday and informs appointments are only Mon-Sat
phases.recoveryHint: If bot accepts Sunday (may not validate day), provide a safe weekday date to complete booking
